mechanism: Betamethasone may increase pramipexole metabolism via CYP3A4 induction and can potentiate CNS effects including dizziness and orthostatic hypotension; corticosteroids may also worsen parkinsonian symptoms.
action: Monitor for reduced pramipexole efficacy and increased orthostatic hypotension; consider dose adjustment if betamethasone is initiated or discontinued; counsel on fall risk and CNS adverse effects.
